## Services

- [Home, office & shop key duplication](https://keymaker-ecity.pages.dev/#key-duplication): Spare house keys, cupboard keys, padlock keys and office or shop keys. We also cut compatible computerised and dimple keys after checking the original key profile.
- [Car & bike keys, remotes & fobs](https://keymaker-ecity.pages.dev/#car-bike-keys): Key making and replacement for supported vehicles, compatible chip and remote programming, and new electronic key fobs. Replacement remote shells and covers are available for compatible models.
- [24-hour emergency lockout help](https://keymaker-ecity.pages.dev/#emergency-lockout): Locked out of your home, office, shop or vehicle? Call for assistance for authorised owners and occupants. We’ll confirm service availability, your location and the applicable charges.
- [Door lock repair & replacement](https://keymaker-ecity.pages.dev/#door-lock-repair): Help with sticking, faulty or damaged main-door and security locks. We repair, replace or install compatible locks, cylinders, handles, bolts and grille-lock hardware.
- [Lock rekeying & window locks](https://keymaker-ecity.pages.dev/#rekeying-window-locks): Rekeying for suitable locks and repair or replacement of compatible window-lock fittings. We assess the existing mechanism before recommending parts or work.
- [Safe opening & lock repairs](https://keymaker-ecity.pages.dev/#safe-services): Safe opening, lock installation and repair for authorised owners. Share the safe type and the problem so we can discuss the available service and provide a quote.

## Prepare an enquiry

1. Identify the requested service and whether the customer plans a shop visit or needs on-site assistance.
2. For duplicate keys, ask whether an original is available. For vehicle keys, ask for the vehicle make, model and year. For lock repair, ask for the lock type and problem. Share photos only if the customer chooses to do so.
3. For an on-site enquiry, use the area the customer chooses to share. Do not request identity documents, security codes, precise location or payment details in this website workflow.
4. Offer the phone link or a WhatsApp draft. The user sends the message or authorises contact. Opening a link does not book a visit.
5. Let the shop confirm parts, service support, arrival time and quote. Do not claim that a job is booked, guarantee a ten-minute arrival, or invent prices, stock levels or discounts.

Lockout and safe-opening work is for authorised owners or occupants. Ownership checks are handled directly by the shop. This document does not provide lock bypass instructions.

## Customer questions

### Where is your key maker and locksmith shop?

Find us on Gollahalli Main Road, Siraj Layout, Electronic City Phase 1, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560100. Look for the red Key Maker & Locksmith signboards and blue shutters in our shop photo.

### Are you open at night and on weekends?

Yes. The shop and locksmith assistance are available 24 hours, Monday to Sunday. For urgent help, call to confirm availability and an arrival estimate for your location.

### Do you provide doorstep locksmith service?

Yes. We serve the 20 listed areas around Electronic City and accept call-outs 10 km or more from our shop. Share your exact address to confirm availability, arrival time and any travel charges.

### Can you make a key for my car or bike?

We make keys for supported cars, bikes and scooters. Send the make, model, year and existing key details so we can check the required blank, cutting and any chip or remote programming.

### Does a car remote shell include programming?

A shell is the outer casing, not automatically a complete programmed key. We check which components can be reused and quote separately for a blade, electronics, cutting or programming where needed.

### What should I bring for duplicate keys?

Bring a working original key if you have one. For specialist keys or locks, contact us with the key or lock type before travelling. Restricted or incompatible key systems may require a different solution.

### What will a key or locksmith job cost?

We confirm the quote for your specific key, lock, parts and work. Cutting, programming, fitting, emergency attendance and travel can affect the final price. Ask what is included before work begins.

### Which payment methods do you accept?

Cash, UPI and bank transfers through IMPS or NEFT. Cards are not currently accepted.
